rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0015, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-5 (one knob vs iter-1). NUMBERS n_outer sweep at n_bands=6: n_outer0 RMSE0.401(PSNR-1.4), n_outer2 RMSE0.0247(PSNR22.8 BEST-so-far), n_outer4 RMSE0.114(PSNR9.55). The residual-refinement loop has an INTERIOR optimum near n_outer=2: too few passes leave step-1s 205x-scale error uncorrected, too many accumulate densified-residual-FBP noise and DIVERGE. Best classical RMSE (0.0247) is still 4.7x the 0.00521 FBP baseline -> hr=0. ONE KNOB: wu_n_outer 2 -> 1 to bracket the interior optimum on the low side. HYPOTHESIS: if n_outer=1 gives RMSE between 0.401 and 0.0247, the optimum is at 2 (confirmed) and I move to a DIFFERENT knob (soft_thresh, to reduce residual-add-back noise); if n_outer=1 UNEXPECTEDLY beats 0.0247, one correction pass is cleaner than two and the second pass is already injecting divergence-noise -> optimum is n_outer=1. Budget: ~seconds.
